sv.title: Demokrat vinner i Alaska – alla senatsval klara
sv.summary: Den sista platsen i USA:s senat går till Alaska-demokraten Mary Peltola, beräknar flera amerikanska medier. – Tack Alaska, vi gjorde det, säger Peltola i ett videoklipp på sociala medier.

en.title: Democrat wins in Alaska – all Senate races decided
en.summary: The last seat in the US Senate goes to Alaska Democrat Mary Peltola, several American media outlets estimate. “Thank you Alaska, we did it,” Peltola says in a video clip on social media.
